acceptance_criteria.text: Adopt only Root-released synchronized green staging containing accepted Provider and repaired ETF checkpoints; preserve owned preparation/history, classify shared paths, upstream ownership and immutable Study outputs.

Main Workstation and chart UI support explicit unknown-symbol source discovery and verified identity selection; cryptographic request IDs work on actual private HTTP origins; mount, typing and hydration remain local-only.

Explicit bounded selected-chart history requests use verified identity/timeframe/range/adjustment/source, preserve explicit adjusted=false, prevent fanout/stale-scope updates, and render local readback; held/error retains cache and TC does not implement provider routing/ingestion.

Explicit first-use ETF issuer acquisition and resolved holding-chart handoff preserve composition date, known-at, provenance and snapshot identity; historical/stale data remains display-only and never silently becomes current analytic input.

Source-matched required local unit/build/lint, functional and strict visual profile and exact branch CI pass without changing ordinary-click, keyboard/mobile, TC appearance, references, masks, tolerances or zero retries; controlled cases are preparation, not full combined or genuine source proof.

Durable handoff records exact implementation/closing source and image inputs, tested contracts/defaults/migration impact, limitations and all nine roadmap dispositions; only owned cleanup is proved while persistent and sibling resources remain preserved; Root acceptance stays pending until gates/review pass.
